note: Election of county councillors for the County of Londonderry in 1952. The returning officer's official 'Result of Elections Notice' (Derry Journal, 6 June 1952, dated 5 June 1952) declares all nineteen members elected for the nineteen county electoral divisions without a poll; no votes are recorded in the notice. No party labels were printed. Returned unopposed.
